$comment: Cases that do not match Node yet, by target, each with its cause. The diff run reports them without failing, and fails when one matches Node so it is removed here. Owners: the Kotlin translator (src/kotlin.ts) and runtime (kit-android runtime).

swift.227-callback-given-undefined: A string parameter given undefined reads "", and a void promise's value is not undefined (Swift translator).
swift.231-regexp-unset-group: A capture group that took no part in the match reads "", not undefined (Swift translator).
swift.232-async-object-return: An object literal an async function returns is not made as its declared Promise's type (Swift translator).
swift.234-define-property-instance: Object.defineProperty on a class instance or an array is dropped (Swift translator and runtime, SEMANTICS #3).
swift.235-static-block: static { } blocks have no effect (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #4).
swift.237-shared-top-names: Top-level names (an enum, files of the same name in two folders) that several modules declare clash; swiftc crashes (Swift translator).
swift.238-builtin-constructors-as-values: Built-in constructors used as values (map(Number), filter(Boolean), e.constructor === TypeError) do not compile (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #7).
swift.239-destructuring-assignment: Destructuring assignment to existing variables is refused (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #8).
swift.242-var-redeclared: A var declared again, or declared in a loop head or branch and used after it, does not compile (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #14).
swift.243-array-holes: Object.keys lists the holes of new Array(n) (Swift runtime).
swift.244-optional-member-later: An optional member set after the object is made is listed in declaration order, not as the last key (Swift translator).
swift.246-nullable-string-concat: `null as string | null` in a template or a concatenation does not compile: nil has no contextual type (Swift translator).
swift.247-missing-values-throw: A module const read before its declaration runs, and a member of undefined or null read, set or called, trap instead of throwing ReferenceError or TypeError (Swift translator, quality step 4).
swift.248-function-properties: Properties given to a function value (`fn.tag = …`, Object.defineProperty) and Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call on one are refused or dropped (Swift translator and runtime, SEMANTICS #3).
swift.249-literal-to-primitive: An object literal's own [Symbol.toPrimitive] is ignored, and a literal's valueOf is not called by < or Math.max (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #5).
swift.341-error-classes-as-values: A value typed ErrorConstructor does not compile: fixed on wip/builtin-values (edff2a359), drop this entry when it merges (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #7).

kotlin.235-static-block: Fixed on wip/quality-kotlin (033903a0d): remove this once both are on feat.
kotlin.238-builtin-constructors-as-values: Fixed on wip/quality-kotlin (ff45852f3): remove this once both are on feat.
kotlin.241-regexp-call: Fixed on wip/quality-kotlin (82ce38739): remove this once both are on feat.
kotlin.242-var-redeclared: Fixed on wip/quality-kotlin (82ce38739): remove this once both are on feat.
kotlin.270-json-edges: JSON.parse and JSON.stringify edges the Swift perf round covers: number forms, escapes, toJSON and replacer order, syntax error messages (Kotlin runtime, being fixed in the Kotlin perf work).
kotlin.272-collections-edges: Map and Set edges: SameValueZero keys, iteration while the collection changes, a held iterator across deletes (Kotlin runtime, being fixed in the Kotlin perf work).
kotlin.274-promise-reactions: The order of several reactions on one promise, finally, and resolution with thenables (Kotlin runtime, being fixed in the Kotlin perf work).
kotlin.280-callback-function-values: Array.from of a Set is an array of Any? and a function declaration passed by name to reduce matches no overload (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.341-error-classes-as-values: An error constructor held as a value typed ErrorConstructor (instanceof C, C.name, an array of them) does not compile (Kotlin translator, SEMANTICS #7).
kotlin.345-static-block-var-scope: Static blocks and a var read outside the block declaring it: wip/quality-kotlin has both (033903a0d, 82ce38739); check this case there once both are on feat.
